build_now: Choose the smallest useful set of features from the user's scope that delivers the fastest aha moment through a complete core workflow, honoring explicit user priorities.

app_meta.etymology: Agos is the Filipino word for 'flow' — embodying seamless liquidity, transparent treasury movements, and dynamic financial velocity for Philippine enterprises.
app_meta.target_audience: Philippine startups, scaleups, and MSMEs (founders, finance managers, operations leads, department heads).

compliance_and_simulation_notes.simulated_cards_disclaimer: Demo Card — Not Valid for Payment
compliance_and_simulation_notes.no_third_party_brand_marks: No Visa/Mastercard logos or trademarks anywhere on virtual or physical card interfaces.
compliance_and_simulation_notes.synthetic_data_indicator: Synthetic demo datasets prominently flagged with 'Simulated' badge.
compliance_and_simulation_notes.stellar_testnet_indicator: Real Stellar Testnet transactions flagged with live 'Stellar Testnet' badge and direct Horizon testnet block explorer links.

user_archetypes.context: Early-to-growth startup executive needing top-level cash flow visibility, fast dual-currency runway tracking, and quick high-value approval sweeps on mobile/laptop.
primary_jobs: Monitor cross-border treasury / supplier payments via Stellar Testnet

user_archetypes.context: Day-to-day controller reconciling expenses against BIR-ready categorization, issuing department cards, managing departmental budgets, and approving payables.
primary_jobs: Reconcile synthetic and live bank/crypto transactions
Enforce budget guardrails and issue freeze/limit changes on corporate cards

user_archetypes.context: Spends on digital ads (Meta, Google), SaaS subscriptions (Figma, Notion), and local vendor deliveries; needs clear spend limits and instant receipt upload.
primary_jobs: Submit expense claim with official receipt (OR)

locale_and_philippines_context.local_tax_and_compliance: Official Receipt (OR) upload field, BIR 2307 Withholding Tax status tracking, and 12% VAT breakdown indicator.

tradeoff_analysis.workspace_structure: Left Collapsible Navigation Sidebar (240px expanded / 64px collapsed) with contextual breadcrumbs and top action bar vs. purely Horizontal Top Navigation. Sidebar chosen because financial operators switch rapidly across 10 distinct sub-modules (Expenses, Budgets, Approvals, Cards, Payments, Stellar, Reports, etc.) and require persistent vertical grouping without horizontal crowding on typical 1366px-1920px finance laptop screens.
tradeoff_analysis.detail_view_pattern: Slide-over Drawer (Inspector Panel, 480px width) for transaction, card, and approval details vs. Full-page Navigation. Drawer chosen because finance controllers perform batch inspection: reviewing 15 expenses in succession while keeping the table filter state, scroll position, and active pagination intact.

visual_personality_evaluation.direction_a: Cool Slate & Electric Cyan (Crypto-first, stark black backgrounds, high neon contrast). Rejected: feels too speculative and unregulated for Philippine enterprise CFOs.
visual_personality_evaluation.direction_b_selected: Sovereign Maritime & Clean Alpine (Deep Pacific Navy, Crisp White surfaces, Subtle Sea-Mist Canvas, and Muted Cyan for Stellar Testnet). Selected: projects institutional trust, modern fintech elegance (reminiscent of Brex/Mercury), high-legibility tabular figures, and clear separation between fiat Philippine Peso operations and Stellar blockchain rails.

visual_system.color_model: OKLCH (All specified coordinates strictly verified in sRGB gamut and meeting WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA contrast targets)

typography.family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
typography.font_rationale: IBM Plex Sans brings a humanist, sober, slightly narrow geometry engineered explicitly for high-density financial interfaces and institutional clarity. Tabular figures ('tnum') prevent numeral jitter across columns.
rules: Use IBM Plex Sans for all interface copy, metrics, currency amounts, dates, and account numbers.
Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on all financial amounts, balance counters, and transaction tables.
Right-align all currency and quantitative columns.
IBM Plex Mono is strictly reserved for machine artefacts: Stellar public keys (G...), transaction hashes (tx hash), API secret keys, and webhook endpoints.
No display or decorative fonts inside the business dashboard. Font weights: 400 for body/secondary labels, 500 for row primary titles and table headers, 600 for card headlines and view page titles.

spatial_system.density: Compact to medium for tabular data; generous breathing room for high-level KPI cards and marketing landing pages.

navigation_architecture.structure: Hybrid Layout with persistent Left Vertical Sidebar for Authenticated App and Sticky Minimalist Top Bar for Public/Marketing Pages.
navigation_architecture.mobile_adaptation: On screens under 768px, sidebar turns into a slide-over sheet triggered by top hamburger icon. Quick tab bar at the bottom provides instant thumb access to Overview, Expenses, Approvals, and Cards.

public_views.title: Early Access Waitlist & Admin Oversight
components: Public intake form capturing Company Name, Work Email, Team Size (1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 200+), Monthly Spend Bracket, and Stellar/Cross-border interest.
Instant confirmation screen with position badge and unique referral token.
Protected Admin View: tab for ISLA Ventures operators to review submissions, filter by spend bracket, and mark accounts as 'Approved for Sandbox Demo' or 'Contacted'.

app_core_views.title: Financial Operating Overview
app_core_views.purpose: Provides the primary actor with instant situational awareness of liquidity, 30-day burn rate, upcoming payables, and pending approvals.

layout_structure.top_bar: Entity selector ('ISLA Ventures Inc. - HQ'), PHP/USD/XLM balance toggle, 'Simulated Data' badge, 'New Payment' quick-action button.

action_split.left_col: Pending Approvals Queue Preview (3 urgent items with 1-click Approve/Reject)
action_split.right_col: Recent Multi-Rail Activity (Interleaved PHP bank transfers, simulated card debits, and Stellar testnet payments)

app_core_views.title: Corporate Expenses & Receipts
app_core_views.purpose: Audit, filter, and reconcile all company expenditures with BIR-ready tax categorizations.
features: Interactive filters: Rail (All, Card, Bank, Stellar), Status (Pending OR, Approved, Reconciled), Department (Eng, Ops, Mktg, Exec), Date Range.

Table columns: Transaction Date, Merchant/Recipient, Employee, Card/Account, Department, Category (BIR classification), Tax Flag (VAT / Withholding 2307), Amount (PHP with tabular numerals), Receipt Status, Action.
Inspector Drawer (480px): opens on row click to show receipt image thumbnail, OCR parsed data, GL code, employee notes, and audit timeline.
Action bar: Export CSV, Upload Missing Receipt modal, Bulk Reconcile.

app_core_views.title: Departmental & Project Budgets
app_core_views.purpose: Real-time visibility into envelope budgeting, hard spending limits, and burn velocity.
features: Budget Cards Grid: Engineering SaaS, Growth & Marketing, Manila Office Ops, Cross-Border Contractor Pool.
Progress bars with 3-tier color coding: <70% Teal/Navy, 70-89% Amber warning, >=90% Red alert.
Budget drilldown: List of linked simulated cards and active approval policies under each envelope.
Action: 'Create New Budget Envelope' modal with automated limit freeze thresholds.

app_core_views.title: Multi-Tier Approval Queue
app_core_views.purpose: High-velocity inbox for founders and finance heads to inspect and authorize out-of-policy or high-ticket payments.
features: Priority categorization: Urgent (>₱100k or vendor due in <24h), Routine, and Past Approved/Rejected history.
Review Card: Requesting employee, Department, Vendor name, Item description, Attached quote/invoice, Rule violation flag (e.g. 'Exceeds standard ₱20,000 SaaS limit').
One-click batch operations: 'Approve All Selected' or 'Reject with Reason'.
Approval threshold matrix viewer in contextual side drawer.

app_core_views.title: Corporate Cards (Simulated Engine)
app_core_views.purpose: Issue and supervise virtual and physical cards for founders and team members without third-party marks.
features: Strict Compliance Notice: Every card surface prominently displays 'Demo Card — Not Valid for Payment' watermark with zero Visa/Mastercard logos.
Simulated Card Visual: Modern obsidian-matte and ocean-gradient finishes, masked card number (•••• •••• •••• 4291), cardholder name, expiry, dynamic CVV button, and company badge 'AGOS · ISLA'.
Card controls: Instant Lock/Unlock switch, Spend Limit adjust slider, Merchant category restrictions (e.g. Block Travel/Entertainment, Allow SaaS only).
Create Card Modal: Multi-use Card vs. Single-use Burner Card, assigned employee, PHP monthly allowance.

app_core_views.title: Payments & Disbursements
app_core_views.purpose: Create and track vendor payments, contractor payouts, and batch disbursements.
features: Transfer Modal: Select Source (PHP Treasury Account, USD Pool, or Stellar Testnet Wallet).
Recipient directory: Saved Philippine bank accounts (BDO, BPI, UnionBank, GCash, Maya) with automated account validation simulation.
Fee transparency box: Shows ₱0 internal transfer fee, simulated ₱15 InstaPay fee, or 0.00001 XLM network fee.

app_core_views.title: Stellar Testnet Treasury Corridor
app_core_views.purpose: Showcase real cryptographic financial infrastructure on Stellar Horizon Testnet for sub-second cross-border settlement.
features: Live Wallet Card: Public Key (e.g., GA5Z...4D2M) with copy button and QR code, Live Testnet Balance (XLM & USDC), Friendbot 10,000 XLM faucet trigger.
Send Payment Corridor: Input destination public key, amount, memo text/hash, and submit live transaction to Stellar Horizon Testnet API.

Cryptographic Verification Table: Real-time ledger sequence numbers, transaction hash (tx_hash), operation fee (stroops), and direct external link to Stellar Laboratory / Horizon testnet block explorer.
Educational Callout: 'Why Stellar for Philippine MSMEs' explaining sub-second settlement, fractions-of-a-cent fees, and 24/7 cross-border liquidity without SWIFT delays.

app_core_views.title: Financial Reports & Smart Reconciliation
app_core_views.purpose: Generate executive-level cash flow statements, P&L estimates, and unmatched transaction reconciliation.
features: Reconciliation workbench: Split view showing synthetic bank feed on left and uploaded receipts/ERP ledger entries on right with match confidence score (e.g. '98% Match by Amount & Date').
One-click 'Accept Match' or 'Create Adjustment Entry'.
Exportable BIR 2307 Withholding Tax summary and Monthly Spend by Cost Center (PDF/CSV).

app_core_views.title: Team Roles & Governance Settings
features: Role-based access control (RBAC): Owner/Founder, Finance Admin, Department Manager, Employee Cardholder.
Security policies: Enforce 2FA, biometric authentication for transactions >₱50,000, Webhook integrations.

interactive_states_and_motion.loading_states: Subtle skeleton pulses using surface_subtle background; table rows show 4 placeholder lines with shimmer.
interactive_states_and_motion.empty_states: Contextual financial empty states with encouraging action button (e.g., 'No pending approvals — your team is completely unblocked.').

validation_rules.monetary_inputs: Must parse valid numeric input; negative values rejected; warns if amount exceeds available envelope budget.
validation_rules.stellar_public_keys: 56-character alphanumeric starting with 'G', memo limited to 28 characters for text memo.

interactive_states_and_motion.feedback_banners: Non-blocking floating toast notifications on lower-right (desktop) or top-center (mobile) with auto-dismiss after 4 seconds.

accessibility_and_responsive.accessibility_standards: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance with 4.5:1 minimum contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large graphical elements.
accessibility_and_responsive.keyboard_navigation: Visible focus ring (2px solid brand_primary with 2px offset) across all interactive table rows, tabs, and form controls.

responsive_breakpoints.mobile: 375px - 767px (Single-column layout, bottom navigation bar, card summary views)
responsive_breakpoints.tablet: 768px - 1023px (Compact sidebar, horizontal scrolling tables with sticky first column)
responsive_breakpoints.desktop: 1024px - 1439px (Default desktop dashboard layout with persistent sidebar and inspector drawers)
responsive_breakpoints.wide_desktop: 1440px+ (Max container constraint 1600px with centered alignment to avoid excessive whitespace)
